title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says

claims.claim: Zelensky affirme que des négociateurs américains ont évoqué un retrait ukrainien du Donbas en échange d'une adhésion à l'Otan
claims.evidence: US negotiators have touted the idea of Ukraine withdrawing its remaining forces from the eastern Donbas region in exchange for Nato membership, Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

claims.claim: Selon Zelensky, c'était la première fois que cette idée était soulevée
claims.evidence: "This was the first time this had been raised," Zelensky said in remarks released by his office on Saturday.

claims.claim: Washington ne confirme pas les propos de Zelensky
claims.evidence: The US has not confirmed the Ukrainian president's comments.

claims.claim: Un responsable américain parle de nombreuses idées en discussion, qui devront être acceptées par les deux parties
claims.evidence: "many ideas continue to be discussed but any final deal will have to be agreed to by both parties"

claims.claim: Jared Kushner a appelé à la « confidentialité »
claims.evidence: Jared Kushner appeared keen to dampen down any US offer of Nato membership for Ukraine, urging "confidentiality" in a sensitive process.

claims.claim: Kushner a dénoncé des propositions « maximalistes »
claims.evidence: He said that "maximalist" proposals had been reported from the negotiations, along with "strong political rhetoric".

claims.claim: Zelensky soumettrait à référendum une offre précise avec garanties de sécurité, sans limites à l'armée et avec fonds de reconstruction
claims.evidence: if he received a specific proposal that contained security guarantees, no constraints on Ukraine's military and funds to rebuild the country, he would put it to a referendum.

claims.claim: La Russie occupe environ un cinquième de l'Ukraine et l'essentiel du Donbas
claims.evidence: Russia currently occupies roughly a fifth of Ukrainian territory, including most of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions that compose the Donbas.

claims.claim: La Russie n'a pas changé de position
claims.evidence: Comments by both Putin and Kremlin officials suggest that Russia's position on the war has not shifted.

claims.claim: La Russie rejette toute adhésion de l'Ukraine à l'Otan
claims.evidence: Russia has said another Nato member on its border was unacceptable. / The Kremlin has always been fiercely opposed, too.

claims.claim: La Russie exige la cession des zones du Donbas non conquises avant tout cessez-le-feu
claims.evidence: it will not agree to a ceasefire until a final peace deal is in place that would include Ukraine ceding control of those parts of the Donbas Russian troops have not captured

why_it_matters.explanation: Le lien entre Otan, concessions territoriales et négociations de paix découle des faits de l'article sans ajouter de fait nouveau.
